text: せなかの　カラは　くずれやすいが　ときどき　たいないを　めぐっている　こうねつの　ほのおが　ふきだす。

structure.jp: せなかの　カラは　くずれやすいが
structure.en: the shell on its back crumbles easily, but

structure.jp: ときどき　たいないを　めぐっている　こうねつの　ほのおが
structure.en: now and then the very hot flames circulating inside its body

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb means it happens easily. くずれやすい = 'crumbles easily'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: たいないを　めぐっている　こうねつの　ほのお
patterns.explanation: The phrase ending in a verb describes the thing that comes after it. たいないを　めぐっている　こうねつの　ほのお = 'the very hot flames that circulate inside its body'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a sentence part means 'but'. くずれやすいが = 'it crumbles easily, but'.
